author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at how your ownership of the hardware you own is being threatened for the last few years. Prices have skyrocketed and the companies responsible are introducing a new way to use computers which remains locked away behind server access. This is a reality where your basic ownership will be stripped away and the quicker you realize that the faster we can turn things around. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Why Your Computer Will Soon Be Dead...
